title: Interactive solution-space atlas
summary: Shipped an interactive map that lets visitors explore reusable capability combinations by problem, lifecycle stage and scale, with direct routes into the underlying method profiles.
why_it_matters: It turns a large method catalogue into a problem-first proof surface, making the work easier to understand, navigate and reuse without presenting capability membership as a score or maturity claim.

title: When a Rule Is Not a Control
summary: Published a technical guide on separating instruction, authority, enforcement, verification and preservation when AI agents can change real state, including bounded behavioural evidence from the implementation case.
why_it_matters: It turns a concrete governance failure mode into a reusable engineering distinction: telling an agent the rule is not the same thing as enforcing the boundary.
